deployments_detail.use: Blue Yonder AI/ML for demand forecasting & supply-chain optimisation across 600+ supermarkets; Microsoft gen-AI for customer/colleague experience; aims to be UK's "leading AI-enabling grocer"

Five-year strategic partnership with Microsoft to become an 'AI-enabled grocer': generative AI to improve online product search and shopping experience, plus ML/AI to optimise store operations (e.g. shelf-edge cameras guiding colleagues to shelves needing replenishment). [Microsoft (Azure AI / OpenAI)]

AI/ML-powered demand forecasting and store replenishment/ordering across the end-to-end supply chain (including fresh), plus digital control tower and space/macro-space planning. [Blue Yonder (formerly JDA)]

Purpose-built machine-learning platform (built by Accenture on Google Cloud) that ingests, cleans and classifies structured and unstructured data (social posts, blogs) to spot emerging food trends and predict changing customer tastes for assortment decisions. [Google Cloud; Accenture]

AI-powered self-checkout terminals delivering personalised promotions and real-time store analytics, with AI to recognise unbarcoded items (loose fruit/veg); associates approve transactions remotely via tablet. [NCR Voyix]
Microsoft Copilot rolled out to store support centre and store management colleagues to automate routine administrative work and free up time. [Microsoft Copilot]

Nectar360 Pollen retail-media platform uses a custom multi-agent AI system (YOLO object detection, OCR, OpenAI and Gemini LLMs as reasoning engines) to automate brand/legal compliance checks on ad creative for Sainsbury's and Argos. [DEPT (build partner); OpenAI + Google Gemini LLMs; YOLO; OCR]
deployments_detail.value: Approval time cut from 1-3 weeks to ~90 seconds; ~$0.01 cost per asset audit; 91%+ accuracy; 130+ compliance checks per asset

deployments_detail.use: Your Nectar Prices personalised pricing: AI/automation combines each Nectar member's purchase history to generate up to 10 individualised weekly price offers, delivered via app/SmartShop/website and now at physical tills. [Nectar / Sainsbury's (in-house, part of Microsoft AI programme)]
deployments_detail.value: Up to 10 personalised offers per week per member

deployments_detail.use: Live facial-recognition (Facewatch) in stores that scans shoppers' faces against a watchlist of repeat offenders to deter shoplifting; started as an eight-week trial, expanding to ~200 stores. [Facewatch]
AI-driven video scanning at self-service checkouts ('VAR-style' cameras) that check whether items are properly scanned and flag scan-avoidance/mis-scans to reduce shrink. [none named]
